lessons.lesson: Do not enter SHORT positions when both squeeze momentum has released BULLISH and CMF shows BULL momentum, regardless of CVD direction or prior trend structure.

lessons.lesson: Do not enter SHORT when TTM Squeeze has just released bullish and StochRSI is above 85, as explosive momentum continuation typically invalidates counter-trend setups regardless of CVD or cluster balance.

lessons.lesson: Never execute a trade flagged as WEAK SETUP or WAIT by AI. Require all momentum indicators (squeeze, CVD, CMF) to align with trade direction before entry; reject setups where 50%+ of momentum signals oppose the intended direction.

lessons.lesson: Never enter trades when Confidence is below 40% AND regime is RANGE with Chop > 50, regardless of directional bias confirmation. Wait for either confidence above 40% or regime shift to TREND before execution.

lessons.lesson: Do not enter SHORT positions when squeeze momentum is RELEASED/BULLISH; wait for momentum to flip bearish or squeeze to reset neutral before executing counter-momentum trades, regardless of CVD strength.

lessons.lesson: Do not enter trades with confidence below 50% when market structure is RANGE and volume climax exceeds 4x; wait for confirmed BOS/CHoCH in trending structure before execution.
